cases.cmd: "$BIN" d txt bak | sort; ls d | tr '\n' ' '
cases.stdout:
a.txt -> a.bak
b.txt -> b.bak
a.bak b.bak notes.md

cases.name: the content moves with the name
only the last extension
cases.cmd: "$BIN" d gz zip | sort; ls d | tr '\n' ' '

cases.name: a name that is only the extension
cases.cmd: "$BIN" d txt bak; echo "rc=$?"; ls -A d | tr '\n' ' '

cases.name: hidden files count
cases.cmd: "$BIN" d a b; ls -A d | tr '\n' ' '

cases.name: the new name ends with the old extension
cases.cmd: "$BIN" d c x.c | sort; ls d | tr '\n' ' '
cases.stdout:
a.c -> a.x.c
b.c -> b.x.c
c.c -> c.x.c
a.x.c b.x.c c.x.c

cases.name: an existing target is not overwritten
cases.cmd: "$BIN" d txt bak >o.txt 2>&1; echo "rc=$?"; sort o.txt; cat d/a.bak; ls d | tr '\n' ' '
cases.setup: mkdir d; echo keep > d/a.bak; echo new > d/a.txt; echo b > d/b.txt
cases.stdout:
rc=1
b.txt -> b.bak
renameext: a.txt: target exists
keep
a.bak a.txt b.bak

cases.name: exit status when something is skipped
missing directory
cases.stdout:
renameext: nope: No such file or directory
rc=1

cases.name: wrong arguments
cases.stdout:
usage: renameext DIR OLD NEW
rc=2
